camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/sendWorkItemMessage --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'collaborationGroupId=cg_9401&content=请根据刚才的讨论整理下一步行动清单。' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Sends a user message to a work item topic
description_zh: 向工作项话题发送用户消息
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo send-work-item-message --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --content '请根据刚才的讨论整理下一步行动清单。' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendWorkItemMessage

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID；缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration space
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the free exploration work item. This parameter is compatible with the legacy-topic:<conversationId> format. You must specify at least one of workItemId and conversationId. If both are specified, they must point to the same session
parameters.help_zh: 自由探索工作项 ID，兼容 legacy-topic:<conversationId>；与 conversationId 至少传一个，双传须指向同一会话
parameters.name: work_item_id

parameters.help_en: The conversation ID returned by the API operation for creating a free exploration. You must specify at least one of this parameter and workItemId. If both are specified, they must match
parameters.help_zh: 创建自由探索接口返回的 conversation_id；与 workItemId 至少传一个，双传须一致
parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.example: 请根据刚才的讨论整理下一步行动清单。
parameters.help_en: The body of the user message. The value cannot be empty and can be up to 32,768 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户消息正文，不能为空白，最多32768字符
parameters.name: content

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate backend error codes
code.description_zh: 业务状态码；成功为200，失败为后端错误码

message.description_en: The error description. This parameter is empty if the request is successful

messageId.description_en: The ID of the assistant message. The reply is generated asynchronously in the background
messageId.description_zh: 助手消息 ID，回复在后台异步生成

sessionId.description_en: The ID of the existing topic session

userMessageId.description_en: The ID of the user message

workItemId.description_en: The work item ID in the request. If only conversationId is specified, a compatible ID in the legacy-topic:<conversationId> format is returned
workItemId.description_zh: 请求中的工作项 ID；仅传 conversationId 时返回 legacy-topic:<conversationId> 兼容 ID
